name: rubiks-cube-tracker
description: Rubik's Cube move tracker with animated rotations and guided reverse mode.

scripts.build-js: browserify src/main.ts -p [tsify] -t [ babelify --global true ] --debug | terser -c --source-map "content='inline',url='bundle.js.map'" -o dist/bundle.js
scripts.build: npm run prep && npm run build-js && npm run build-html
